name: codex-repo-sync
description: Fetch Git repositories at Codex session start and route unsafe integration decisions to the active Codex task.

interface.shortDescription: Fetch and safely reconcile repositories before Codex works.
interface.longDescription: Fetches the active Git repository when a Codex session starts, safely fast-forwards clean branches, and gives the active Codex task branch-aware instructions for merges that require judgment.
defaultPrompt: Show the repository freshness report for this task.
